assumptions.text: The per-file rule stands: an entry is a FILE with its own reason, and B-2's three controls (the near-miss refusal, the directory refusal, the reading) stay exactly as they are.
assumptions.alternative: Declaring a class of path (any docs/L2|L3/<module>/ page a pass edits), refused because it would admit B-2(b)'s near-miss by construction and delete the row's only proof it can fail.

assumptions.text: One reading still covers the WHOLE tree: a per-unit reading may sit beside it, but nothing may let an undeclared cross-module edit pass.
assumptions.alternative: Replacing the whole-repo reading with per-unit ones, which would let every cross-module page this session edited pass undeclared.

assumptions.text: The unit's scope is the instrument: no src/ byte, no product behaviour, no module's claimed paths, no reworded D-n.
assumptions.alternative: Folding the grain change into a product unit, which would move two subjects in one landing.

assumptions.text: The tax is measured rather than felt: six extensions in one session, 262 entries, 248 outside the owning module, each extension a delegation to another module's L2 for a one-line edit.
assumptions.alternative: Treating the friction as anecdotal, which is what D-298's and D-299's own passes each did once before this row counted it.
